from collections import Counter
base=Counter({k:v//8 for k,v in Counter(open('salad.txt').read().split()).items()})

closing='''When the steps below are complete, determine which final label is on the box that currently contains each object. res=base-Counter(intro)-Counter(closing)
neg=(Counter(intro)+Counter(closing))-base
print('NEG',neg)
print('RES count',sum(res.values()))
for k,v in sorted(res.items()): print(k,v)
